subject: Clarifying tiered discount structure + legal carveouts for PilotBundle
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@legalbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot pricing — confirmation on tiered discounts and carveouts

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. We like the performance profile you showed for the conversational throughput. Before we proceed to procurement, two quick asks so we can present a clean request to Finance and Legal: 

1) Can you confirm the effective discount schedule for the PilotBundle if we size at 150M tokens/mo vs 300M tokens/mo? The term sheet draft we received lists a single blended discount and our CFO is asking for the exact tiers and breakpoints.

2) Legal has asked whether Redwood can accept a carveout for specific data retention obligations for regulated PII samples collected during the pilot (i.e., we need a limited-term data retention exception tied to this pilot only). Is that something you’ll entertain, or do you only offer platform-level retention controls?

If you can send an updated term sheet or a short note that we can attach to the purchase request, that would help. We’re aiming to have internal approvals by Friday.

Appreciate it,
Samir

—
Samir Patel
Director, Cloud Platform Procurement
NovaCorp
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@legalbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing — confirmation on tiered discounts and carveouts

Samir —

Thanks for the questions and for the time today. Quick answers up front, then I’ll attach a redline of the term sheet with the explicit breakpoints.

1) Discount tiers: we can provide explicit tiered discounts rather than a blended rate. For PilotBundle the standard schedule we propose is:
   - 0–100M tokens/mo: list price (no discount)
   - 100M–250M tokens/mo: 15% discount off list
   - 250M–500M tokens/mo: 25% discount off list

   Practically, at 150M tokens you land in the 15% band; at 300M you’d get the 25% band. We can also offer a one-time onboarding credit (applied as a bill credit) if you commit to a 6-month pilot, which effectively increases the first-month discount. I’ve added a line in the term sheet with precise math examples.

2) Legal carveout for PII retention during the pilot: we understand the need for a scoped exception. Redwood’s baseline is platform-level retention controls, but we do support limited, documented carveouts for pilots with the following guardrails:
   - Exception limited to pilot scope and timebox (we’d accept retention for up to 90 days for specified datasets)
   - Specified dataset definitions (by dataset ID or collection point) — we need NovaCorp to enumerate these in writing
   - Technical controls in place (encrypted-at-rest with customer-managed keys if requested)
   - Audit logging enabled for access to those datasets

I’ve looped in Alicia from your legal team and Connor from ours to help align on exact language. Attached is PilotBundle-term-sheet-v3.pdf with the discount table and a short redline covering the carveout language. Also attaching a small usage-estimates-novacorp.xlsx so you can see the sample billing math.

Next steps: Marissa will follow up with a clear pricing scenario and a one-page summary for your Finance team. If the carveout looks acceptable, we can slot a short legal call tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Evelyn

—
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@legalbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing — confirmation on tiered discounts and carveouts

Hi Samir —

Dropping the concrete numbers you can paste into your internal request. I used the estimates you provided in the workbook to show the delta between a 3-month and 6-month pilot at two sizing points. Key highlights:

- 150M tokens/mo (3-month pilot): list rate $0.0009/token; 15% discount => $0.000765/token => estimated monthly charge $114,750. One-time onboarding credit = $10,000 applied in month 1.

- 300M tokens/mo (6-month pilot): list rate $0.0009/token; 25% discount => $0.000675/token => estimated monthly charge $202,500. We can structure a phase ramp (150M first month, 300M month 2+) if you want to preserve lower initial spend while qualifying for the higher tier in month 2.

- If NovaCorp wants an annualized commitment after the pilot, we can discuss deeper tiering (30–40%) but that requires a dedicated capacity commitment.

On the retention carveout: Connor — we’ll need a short statement from engineering confirming the exact retention TTL and that the datasets Samir calls out can be isolated (either by dataset ID or a separate ingest path). If engineering can’t isolate, we’ll decline the carveout and default to platform retention controls.

Samir — I can convert these bullets into a one-page table for Finance and include the billing examples. Tell me which pilot length (3 vs 6 months) you’ll present and I’ll get the table back by EOD.

Thanks,
Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@legalbridge.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing — confirmation on tiered discounts and carveouts

Samir —

Thanks—this looks straightforward and should work for Finance. Two quick operational asks before we finalize: 

1) Can NovaCorp confirm the list of dataset IDs or ingest endpoints that will be in scope for the 90-day retention carveout? Please send that as a short bullet list so our engineers can sign off.

2) If you prefer the phase ramp, we’ll include an explicit line in the term sheet that the higher discount takes effect from the first billing month where sustained usage exceeds the tier breakpoint for at least 60% of that month. That prevents accidental overqualification from a single spike.

If you confirm those two items, I’ll route the updated term sheet to DocuSign and ask Legal to countersign. We can also include the onboarding credit as a line-item credit on the first invoice.

Best,
Rachel

—
Rachel Kim
Senior Contracts Counsel
Redwood Inference
On Wed, 4 Nov 2026 at 08:45 AM, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@legalbridge.com> wrote:
> Hi all —
>
> Quick note from Legal: we’re okay with the timeboxed 90-day pilot retention if NovaCorp provides the dataset identifiers and if Redwood confirms technical isolation. We’d like to add a clause that the carveout explicitly expires at pilot termination and that any persisted PII beyond pilot TTL requires a separate agreement.
>
> Happy to join a brief call to finalize language.
>
> — Alicia
>
